I added the schema as one migration, `supabase/migrations/20261116000000_create_note.sql`. I haven't run it against a database or tested it.

- **Table:** `note` has `id` (uuid primary key, generated), `owner` (uuid, not null, references `auth.users`, deleted along with the user) and `body` (text, required). `owner` defaults to the signed-in user's id, so clients don't have to send it. I also added an index on `owner`.
- **Row-level security:** it is enabled and forced on `note`, with one policy each for select, insert, update and delete. Each policy applies to signed-in users only and checks
